Rippling._comment: Bangalore, lunch and dinner sessions on ONE counter ('Counter 1'). Source: the client's requirement sheet (T1-T5) plus the earlier asks (north + south veg dry, chicken + egg on Wednesday, curd and raita apart, bread 1 a chapati and bread 2 any other bread with a dosa every 10 days). Live row as of 16 Nov 2026: categories welcome_drink, soup, salad, bread, rice, white_rice, veg_dry, veg_gravy, dal, sambar_rasam, curd, curd_side, nonveg_main, dessert; slot_counts bread 2, veg_dry 2, nonveg_main 2; themes Mon/Tue mix, Wed biryani, Thu chinese, Fri north.
Rippling._disable_comment: curd_raita_logic picks curd-or-raita for the single curd_side slot; Rippling has two slots (curd = curd only, curd_side = raita only). nonveg_main_daily_pair wants a dry + a chicken gravy whenever 2+ non-veg slots exist; Rippling's rows are chicken daily and egg on Wednesday, which the rules below state instead.

rules._comment: 'North veg dry and south veg dry irrespective of the theme' (owner, 16 Nov). Bangalore's theme_cuisine_filter verbatim, plus veg_dry in exempt_slots: on Friday (north) the south row otherwise had only north dishes to choose from and quietly took one. The two row rules below keep row 1 north and row 2 south on every day.
rules.name: theme_cuisine_filter
rules._bread_comment: Bread is not cuisine-locked (owner, 18 Nov): bread 1 is a chapati and bread 2 any other bread on every day, a dosa included, as the client's own menus serve (a paratha on the Indo-Chinese day, a dosa on mix days). Chennai does the same.
rules._indian_veg_dry_comment: The Chinese-day filter does not read exempt_slots: it narrowed Thursday's veg dry to Chinese-style dishes (951 -> 64, south 368 -> 1), so from week 2 the South Veg Dry row had nothing south left and was relaxed (17 Nov, 25-day run). On a Chinese day veg dry stays Indian, north or south.

rules._comment: The second non-veg row exists on Wednesday only; every other day it stays blank.
rules.name: rippling_second_nonveg_wed_only

rules._comment: Row 'NonVeg Main (Chicken)': the first non-veg cell is a chicken dish every day.
rules.name: rippling_chicken_first_row

rules._comment: Row 'NonVeg Main (Egg)': the second non-veg cell, which only Wednesday has, is an egg dish.
rules.name: rippling_egg_second_row

rules._comment: Row 'North Veg Dry' is the first veg dry cell. The city rule veg_dry_north_south_pair only asks for one of each per DAY, in either cell; the rows are labelled, so each cell is bound.
rules.name: rippling_north_veg_dry_first_row

rules._comment: Row 'South Veg Dry' is the second veg dry cell.
rules.name: rippling_south_veg_dry_second_row

rules._comment: curd_side is the RAITA slot: a one-slot composition IS 'this slot must be a raita' (repo_map note 20). The plain-curd station is the separate `curd` slot, whose pool is already plain curd only.
rules.name: rippling_raita_only

rules._comment: Plain chapati is the house chapati: Bread 1 may serve it on any day, so it is exempt from unique_items and the 21-day window (flavoured chapatis are not). The dish itself, not its sub_category (17 Nov).
rules.name: rippling_plain_chapati_repeatable

rules._comment: Bread 1 varied (owner, 18 Nov: 'any chapati, varied'): plain chapati may repeat, but on 2 days a week at most, or the planner takes it most days (a 23 Nov dinner test had it on 4 of 5).
rules.name: rippling_plain_chapati_twice_a_week

rules._comment: Bread 1 is a chapati, plain or flavoured (owner, 18 Nov; it was pinned to plain chapati). is_plain_phulka_chapathi is that family: 54 dishes, the 30 flavoured ones included.
rules.name: rippling_first_bread_is_a_chapati

rules._comment: Bread 2 is any other bread, never a chapati (owner, 18 Nov): parathas, naan, kulcha, dosa, idli and so on.
rules.name: rippling_second_bread_not_a_chapati

rules._comment: Bangalore keeps dosa, idly, uthappam and the akki/ragi rotti family to a South day; Rippling has none, and the owner wants a dosa every 10 days (18 Nov). Same selector, allowed on south, mix and biryani days: never on the North Friday or the Chinese Thursday.
rules.name: south_bread_south_day_only

rules._comment: A dosa once every 10 days, compulsory (owner, 18 Nov). No dosa within 10 days of the last one, and once 10 days have passed the week must serve one, so the gap is 10 to 14 days on a five-day week. Counts lunch and dinner history together, like the 21-day window. Lunch and dinner only: breakfast has no bread row.
rules.name: rippling_dosa_every_10_days

rules._comment: The history window cannot see the week being planned, so this keeps it to one dosa inside the week.
rules.name: rippling_dosa_once_a_week

rules._comment: T3: 'Cut fruits or any fruit alone can not come in menu.' fresh_fruit is exactly the 11 fruit-alone desserts (cut fruit, papaya/watermelon cuts, whole banana, orange, seasonal fruit); fruit custard, fruit kesari and banana halwa sit in other sub-categories and stay.
rules.name: rippling_no_fruit_alone_dessert

rules._comment: Kootu is a South Veg Dry here, never a Lentil (slot_pool_moves below), and at most once in 8 days: this is the within-week half. A regional day is exempt (owner, 2026-11-17).
rules.name: rippling_kootu_once_a_week

rules._comment: The cross-week half: no kootu within 8 days of a saved one. No base_slot on purpose: a base_slot scopes the family by course_type, and kootu's course_type is dal.
rules.name: rippling_kootu_8_days

rules._comment: Breakfast: the non-veg sandwich is Friday only, as served in all three weeks of the owner's breakfast sheet (2-20 Nov); 17 Nov's word was Thursday.
rules.name: rippling_breakfast_nonveg_sandwich_friday

rules._comment: Breakfast: the veg sandwich steps aside on the non-veg sandwich day.
rules.name: rippling_breakfast_veg_sandwich_not_friday

rules._comment: Breakfast: Tuesday and Thursday are bread, butter and jam (pinned below), so it repeats; on Monday and Wednesday a real sandwich, so at most those two.
rules.name: rippling_breakfast_bread_jam_repeatable

rules._comment: Breakfast: Veg Healthy is the Salad row (owner, 18 Nov) and the Non Veg main row takes its place on Wednesday.
rules.name: rippling_breakfast_veg_healthy_not_wednesday

rules._comment: Breakfast: eggs are their own pinned row, so the Wednesday non-veg main is never an egg dish.
rules.name: rippling_breakfast_nonveg_main_not_egg

rules._comment: Breakfast: a different kind of main every day of the week (idli, dosa, pongal, paratha, poori ...), as in all three weeks of the owner's sheet.
rules.name: rippling_breakfast_main_one_kind_a_week

rules._comment: Breakfast: the Accompaniments row (two cells) follows the main, one or two dishes (owner, 18 Nov). First matching pair wins; a main with no pair (poha, pancakes, vada alone, kesari bath ...) is not served. Bature and kulcha: chole only; poori: chole or saagu (owner). Idli, dosa, upma/savige, pongal: chutney + sambar (dosa may take saagu, as on 3 Nov). Idiyappam: kadala curry or korma + coconut milk. Paratha/thepla: curd, raita or kadhi + pickle.
rules.name: rippling_breakfast_accompaniments_follow_the_main

rules._comment: Breakfast: each Fruit cell is one fruit; 'seasonal mix fruit bowl (3 varieties)' is the three cells together, not one of them.
rules.name: rippling_breakfast_fruit_not_a_bowl

slot_pool_moves._comment: Kootu out of Lentils, into Veg Dry. It is south Indian, so it lands on the South Veg Dry row.

Rippling._combo_by_theme_comment: Sambar / Rasam is one row (the sambar_rasam combination: rasam three days, sambar two). The biryani day is always rasam, wherever it falls in the plan.

constant_items_by_meal._comment: T1: the make-your-own salad (salad row) and dressings (chutney row, labelled 'Dressing') are fixed per weekday and differ between the lunch and dinner sessions of the one counter. Same every week. Bread 1 is no longer pinned (owner, 18 Nov): see the bread rules.

breakfast._comment: Breakfast sheet (owner, 2026-11-17): the Eggs row (on the 'side' category) and Accompaniments 2 (the 'condiment' category) are fixed text. Sandwich on Tuesday and Thursday is brown bread, butter and jam (owner's sheet, 2-20 Nov).
breakfast.condiment: Chat masala, salt pepper, butter (Amul sachets), kissan jam, ketchup packets

display._comment: T2: the row order and names from the requirement sheet; T4: a veg / non-veg marker on every dish; T5: when each dish was last served (not white rice or pinned items). Shown on screen and in the Excel export, for Rippling only.

by_meal._comment: Breakfast rows in the owner's breakfast sheet order and names (18 Nov). Labels here are laid over the client's, so the breakfast Salad row reads Veg Healthy while lunch keeps Make Your Own Salad.
